Report_RepeatMeasurements function

Source: R/Report_RepeatMeasurements.R, R/rep_Classify.R, R/rep_Controls.R, and 5 more
Report_RepeatMeasurements.Rd

`r lifecycle::badge("experimental")`

Generates the Repeat Measurements report for the repeat-measure KRIs (`kri0020a`–`f`, `cou0020a`–`f`): consecutive identical vital sign values, in five sections: study overview, site/country distribution, participant listing, measure listing and data table.

The flag rule, thresholds, minimum windows and blood pressure view set the report's starting settings; reviewers can change them in the report's Settings panel, which recomputes every participant flag in the browser.

The `rep_*()` functions build the report's pieces. They are exported for the report template and are not intended to be called directly.

Usage

Report_RepeatMeasurements(
  dfResults = NULL,
  dfMetrics = NULL,
  lListings = NULL,
  dSnapshotDate = NULL,
  nWindowLength = NULL,
  strFlagRule = c("count", "rate"),
  vFlagThresholds = NULL,
  nMinWindows = 1,
  strBPMode = c("separate", "combined", "both"),
  bExport = TRUE,
  strContext = "",
  strOutputDir = getwd(),
  strOutputFile = NULL,
  strInputPath = system.file("report", "Report_RepeatMeasurements.Rmd", package =
    "gsm.kri")
)

rep_Classify(
  lListings,
  dfMetrics = NULL,
  nWindowLength = NULL,
  strFlagRule = c("count", "rate"),
  vFlagThresholds = NULL,
  nMinWindows = 1
)

rep_Header(lClass, strStudy, dSnapshotDate = NULL, strContext = "")

rep_Seg(
  strLabel,
  vValues,
  strSelected,
  strAttr,
  strGroup = NULL,
  strIdPrefix = NULL
)

rep_Toolbar(dfVitals, lSettings)

rep_DataTableWide(lClass)

rep_DataTable(dfWide, dfVitals, bExport = TRUE)

rep_ParticipantTiles(lClass)

rep_SiteFlagRows(lClass, dfResults = NULL, dfMetrics = NULL)

rep_SiteRule(dfMetrics = NULL)

rep_VitalRows(lClass)

rep_VitalsListing(dfVitalRows, nWindowLength = NULL, bExport = TRUE)

rep_Vitals()

rep_FlagThresholds(
  strFlagRule = c("count", "rate"),
  vFlagThresholds = NULL,
  dfMetrics = NULL
)

Arguments

dfResults

`data.frame` Reporting results. With `kri0020` results the report colours sites by their KRI flag.

dfMetrics

`data.frame` Reporting metrics (`ID`, `Threshold`, ...). The window length and thresholds come from the `kri0020` rows when present.

lListings

`list` with `Mapped_SUBJ` (`subjid`, `invid`, `country`; `studyid` optional; a missing `invid` or `country` is shown as `"(missing)"`) and `Mapped_VS` (`subjid`, `vs_dt`, optional `visit` and `vsperf_std`, and one numeric column per measure).

dSnapshotDate

`Date` Shown in the report header. Default: the latest `dfResults$SnapshotDate`, if any.

nWindowLength

`integer` Window length when `dfMetrics` has none. Shown in the measure listing header. See "Participant flags".

strFlagRule

`character` Participant flag rule, `"count"` (default) or `"rate"`. See "Participant flags".

vFlagThresholds

`numeric` Amber and Red thresholds for `strFlagRule`: window counts for `"count"`, proportions such as `c(0.2, 0.3)` for `"rate"`. Default `NULL`; see "Participant flags".

nMinWindows

`numeric` Windows a participant needs for a flag. Default 1.

strBPMode

`character` Blood pressure view: `"separate"` (default, systolic and diastolic BP), `"combined"` (paired BP only) or `"both"`.

bExport

`logical` Show the CSV download buttons. Default: `TRUE`.

strContext

`character` HTML shown above the report title, such as a link back to a study page. Inserted as is, so it must be trusted HTML. Default: `""` (none).

strOutputDir

`string` Output directory. Default: working directory.

strOutputFile

`string` Output filename. Default: `Report_RepeatMeasurements.html`.

strInputPath

`string` Path to the template `Rmd`.

lClass

`list` Output of `rep_Classify()`.

strStudy

`character` Study ID(s) shown in the header; missing and empty IDs are dropped.

strLabel

`character` Accessible label of a button group.

vValues

`character` Button labels, named by value.

strSelected

`character` The value pressed initially.

strAttr

`character` Data attribute the script reads, such as `"data-rm-ov"`.

strGroup

`character` Optional. When given, every button sets `strAttr` to `strGroup` and carries its value in `value`.

strIdPrefix

`character` Optional prefix of each button's `id`.

dfVitals

`data.frame` The `vitals` element of `rep_Classify()`. An optional logical `kri` column limits the KRI badge to measures with results.

lSettings

`list` Initial settings: `rule`, `thresholds`, `minWindows` and `bp`.

dfWide

`data.frame` Output of `rep_DataTableWide()`.

dfVitalRows

`data.frame` Output of `rep_VitalRows()`.

Value

`Report_RepeatMeasurements()`: file path of the saved report HTML, returned invisibly. `rep_Classify()`: a `list` (see "Participant flags"). `rep_Header()`, `rep_Toolbar()`, `rep_Seg()`: `htmltools` tags. `rep_DataTable()`, `rep_VitalsListing()`: `DT` htmlwidgets. `rep_FlagThresholds()`: `numeric` Amber, then Red. `rep_SiteRule()`: a `list` with `thresholds` and `accrual`. Other `rep_*()` functions: a `tibble`.

Measures

`rep_Vitals()` lists the measures the report knows: the six scored by `kri0020a`–`f` / `cou0020a`–`f`, paired blood pressure (`bp`), height and BSA. Any other numeric `Mapped_VS` column is also windowed and flagged, but only the six have a KRI. Timing and ID columns are skipped: `studyid`, `subjid`, `invid`, `country`, `visit`, `vs_dt`, `vsperf_std`, and any name (ignoring case) starting with `visit` or ending in `dy`, `num`, `seq` or `id`, plus the report's own `record`, `in_repeat_window` and `window_start`.

Paired blood pressure is report-only and added when `sysbp` and `diabp` are present: one value per record with both, so a window repeats only when both repeat over the same visits. It does not reconcile with `kri0020c` / `kri0020d`.

Participant flags

`rep_Classify()` windows every measure of every enrolled participant once, with the engine behind [Detect_ConsecutiveRepeats()], so every section reads one frame; summing `Numerator` and `Denominator` by site or country reproduces the metrics. A character `vs_dt` must hold ISO dates. When `dfMetrics` has a window length, it wins over `nWindowLength` (with a warning if they differ); otherwise the default is 3.

A participant's flag for a measure comes from [gsm.core::Flag()]: * `"count"`: repeating windows (`Numerator`) against `vFlagThresholds`. * `"rate"`: `Numerator / Denominator` against `vFlagThresholds`.

Amber is at or above the first threshold, Red at or above the second. Participants with fewer than `nMinWindows` windows are `Not evaluable`. `rep_FlagThresholds()` supplies the defaults: 2 and 3 for `"count"`; for `"rate"`, the site-level `kri0020` / `cou0020` `Threshold` in `dfMetrics`, else 0.2 and 0.3. The rate defaults reuse site thresholds at the participant grain, a starting point rather than a calibration: a participant has far fewer windows than a site, so one repeating window moves the rate a lot.

`rep_Classify()` returns a `list` with `participants` (one row per participant and measure, with `Numerator`, `Denominator`, `rate` and `flag`), `measurements` (one row per non-missing measurement with its repeat-window marks), `records` (the enrolled participants' `Mapped_VS` rows with a `record` key), `vitals` (the measures in the report) and `meta` (`window_length`, `window_source`, `rule`, `thresholds`, `min_windows`, and `split_sites`: sites with more than one country, which raise a warning).

Site flags

`rep_SiteFlagRows()` returns one flag per site and measure (`0` Green, `1` Amber, `2` Red, `NA` not evaluated). A KRI measure with `kri0020a`–`f` site results takes the latest KRI flag (`source = "KRI"`); every other measure is flagged in the report with the `kri0020` steps ([gsm.core::Input_Rate()], [gsm.core::Transform_Rate()], [gsm.core::Analyze_Identity()], [gsm.core::Flag()]; `source = "report"`) using `rep_SiteRule()`: Amber and Red at the metric `Threshold` (default 0.2 and 0.3) for sites with at least `AccrualThreshold` windows (default 3).

Report sections

Each section is built from the output of `rep_Classify()` (`lClass`) and sorted by worst flag, then most repeating windows, then participant. * `rep_Header()`, `rep_Toolbar()` and `rep_Seg()` build the header card, the sticky filter strip and its segmented toggle buttons. `rmFilters.js` finds their elements by data attribute and rewrites them as the reviewer changes the settings. * `rep_ParticipantTiles()` returns one tile per participant and measure, drawn by [Widget_RepeatMeasurementsTiles()]. * `rep_VitalRows()` returns the measure listing, one row per participant and measure with aligned, space-separated `values` and `in_repeat_window`; `rep_VitalsListing()` renders it as a `DT` table. * `rep_DataTableWide()` returns one row per `Mapped_VS` record with one column and one `<vital>_in_repeat_window` column per measure; `rep_DataTable()` renders it as a `DT` table, from which the browser also builds the Long table.

The tables name every column so the filter script can find it; their CSV buttons export the rows the filters show.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
Report_RepeatMeasurements(
  dfResults = lReporting$Reporting_Results,
  dfMetrics = lReporting$Reporting_Metrics,
  lListings = list(
    Mapped_VS = lMapped$Mapped_VS,
    Mapped_SUBJ = lMapped$Mapped_SUBJ
  )
)
} # }
